items.name: green-control-theme
items.title: Green Control theme
items.description: Green Control tokens as CSS variables. light = Day, dark = Night. Square corners, one accent.

items.name: green-control-components
items.title: Green Control components
items.description: CSS for the AI components: alert card, evidence chip and card, confidence meter, plan rail, toast with Undo, action row, object link, spark. Install the theme first.

items.name: gc-spinner
items.title: Green Control · Spinner
items.description: A ring that inherits the text colour; used by loading states.

items.name: gc-button
items.title: Green Control · Button
items.description: Square button. One primary per view. States: hover, focus, pressed, disabled, loading.

items.name: gc-state-tag
items.title: Green Control · State tag
items.description: Square dot + word: watching, issue, opportunity, investigating, resolved.

items.name: gc-object-link
items.title: Green Control · Object link
items.description: A dot and an underlined name that opens a machine, team or work order. Missing state.

items.name: gc-evidence-chip
items.title: Green Control · Evidence chip
items.description: Numbered source the AI checked. States: checking, landed, linked, selected, stale.

items.name: gc-confidence-meter
items.title: Green Control · Confidence meter
items.description: Twenty segments and a number; the band (plan, draft, check) is exported.

items.name: gc-ask-input
items.title: Green Control · Ask input
items.description: Ask the AI about the object on screen. States: empty, hover, focus, filled, sending, error.

items.name: gc-segmented
items.title: Green Control · Segmented control
items.description: Two to four options of one thing. One is always on.

items.name: gc-spark
items.title: Green Control · AI spark
items.description: Marks anything the AI wrote. Pulses while it reads sources.

items.name: gc-evidence-card
items.title: Green Control · Evidence card
items.description: One source the AI read: value, bar against normal, caption. Linked and stale states.

items.name: gc-toast
items.title: Green Control · Toast with Undo
items.description: Shown after anything the AI applied. 6 s, pauses on hover, always offers Undo.

items.name: gc-action-row
items.title: Green Control · Action row
items.description: One plan action with live status: planned, running, done, undone, failed.

items.name: gc-owner-row
items.title: Green Control · Owner row
items.description: Suggested team and person on shift; a person confirms with Assign.

items.name: gc-alert-card
items.title: Green Control · Alert card
items.description: Where, what, what it costs, one action. New, investigating, resolved.

items.name: gc-plan-rail
items.title: Green Control · Plan rail
items.description: The AI's plan as numbered steps. Only the current step can be applied; draft asks for review.

items.name: gc-causes-check
items.title: Green Control · Causes & suggested check
items.description: When the AI is not sure: possible causes and one check that tells them apart.

files.content:
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils" import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button" import { CONFIDENCE_REVIEW } from "@/components/ui/confidence-meter" /** * When the AI is not sure: the possible causes and one check that tells them apart. * Below 50% every cause reads "possible" and no fix is offered. * In the draft band (50–79) the leading cause reads "likely"; the others "maybe". */ export interface CausesCheckProps { confidence: number /** Ordered most to least likely. */ causes: string[] check: string onAssign?: () => void onKeepWatching?: () => void className?: string } export function CausesCheck({ confidence, causes, check, onAssign, onKeepWatching, className }: CausesCheckProps) { const low = confidence < CONFIDENCE_REVIEW const label = (i: number) => (low ? "possible" : i === 0 ? "likely" : "maybe") return (
What it could be · {confidence}%
    {causes.map((c, i) => (
  • {c} {label(i)}
    • ))}
Suggested check {check} {low && Not sure enough to suggest a fix yet.}
) }
